rate.definition: -log2(actual installed 16-bit CDF mass) plus exact uniform-bypass symbol lengths from native escape rule; main y stream only
rate.excluded: Main y channel vector excludes z (reported separately), I-frame, SPS/header, RANS state flush and byte renormalization overhead; actual complete stream rate reported separately

context: baseline context/previous output held fixed; no intervention propagated into subsequent frame references
neutral: zero is not guaranteed a conditional neutral point for dequantized means; spatial_mean is the preferred structure-removal control
